description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'FeatureIdInvalidException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project. The exception is thrown when a feature ID is missing or does not match an expected value during message processing. It includes builder methods, static factory methods, and overrides for setting headers, indicating its role in error handling within the messaging component of the project.

It provides multiple constructors, static factory methods, and a nested builder class for flexible instantiation, along with custom error metadata.
